description: Evaluation set for Acme Corp HR Policy Agent. 25 questions covering all required categories.

categories.multi_doc: Questions requiring retrieval from 2+ policy documents
categories.tool_task: Tasks requiring structured data tool calls (employee lookup, PTO balance, etc.)
categories.ambiguous: Ambiguous or incomplete requests requiring clarification
categories.out_of_scope: Questions outside HR policy scope — agent should decline

questions.question: How many PTO days do full-time employees accrue per year after 3 years of service?
questions.gold_answer: 20 days (160 hours) per year, accruing at 6.15 hours per pay period.

questions.question: How much advance notice is required to request 4 days of PTO?
questions.gold_answer: At least 5 business days in advance.

questions.question: Can I expense a personal laptop for reimbursement if mine breaks?
questions.gold_answer: No. Acme Corp provides standard-issue laptops. Employees may not expense a personal laptop as a substitute for the company-provided device.

questions.question: What is the daily meal per diem for domestic business travel?
questions.gold_answer: $75 per day (including all meals).

questions.question: When do full-time employee benefits become effective after hire?
questions.gold_answer: On the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.

questions.question: How long is the employee introductory (probationary) period?
questions.gold_answer: 90 days. The manager completes a 90-Day Performance Review at day 90.
questions.expected_cited_section: Days 61-90 and End of Introductory Period

questions.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave does a primary caregiver receive?
questions.gold_answer: 12 weeks at 100% base salary.

questions.question: What is the annual 401(k) employer match at Acme Corp?
questions.gold_answer: 100% match on the first 3% of salary deferred, and 50% match on the next 2%, for a maximum employer contribution of 4% of salary.

questions.question: I want to work remotely from another state for 6 weeks. What approvals do I need AND what are the security requirements?
questions.gold_answer: Approvals required: manager + HR + Finance (since >30 days). Security requirements per POL-006: must use VPN at all times, only company-issued or MDM-enrolled devices, WPA2/WPA3 home network, no public Wi-Fi without VPN.

questions.question: Can I use my personal iPhone to access company email and Slack? What are the requirements?
questions.gold_answer: Yes, but the device must be enrolled in MDM, have a passcode/biometric lock, run a supported OS version, and have remote wipe capability enabled. Per POL-006, personal devices cannot access Restricted data.

questions.question: I'm a new hire in my first 80 days. Can I take PTO and do I have benefits yet?
questions.gold_answer: PTO cannot be used until after 90 days except for documented medical necessity. Benefits become effective the first of the month following 30 days of employment.

questions.question: I need to travel internationally for business. What approvals do I need and what security precautions must I take?
questions.gold_answer: Approvals: manager + VP + Finance. Register trip 5 days before departure. Use VPN, lock devices in hotel safe, avoid customs-sensitive countries without IT Security clearance. Per POL-010 and POL-006.

questions.question: My employee ID is EMP003 (Carol). Do I have enough PTO to take 5 days off next month?
questions.gold_answer: EMP003 (Carol Lee) has 8.1 available PTO days (65 hours). 5 days = 40 hours, so yes, sufficient balance. Manager approval required with 5+ business days notice.

questions.question: I'm EMP002 (Bob). I want to take 2 days off. Do I have PTO available?
questions.gold_answer: EMP002 (Bob Martinez) has a negative PTO balance (-0.6 days / -4.8 hours). He cannot take 2 days of paid PTO; he may take unpaid leave with manager approval.

questions.question: What medical plan is EMP007 (Grace) enrolled in, and does she have dental coverage?
questions.gold_answer: EMP007 (Grace Park) is enrolled in the PPO Select medical plan (family tier) and has dental insurance enrolled.

questions.question: I'm EMP001 (Alice). I want to work from New York for 6 weeks. Am I eligible and what do I need to do?
questions.gold_answer: EMP001 Alice is fully remote eligible, primary state CA. 6 weeks in NY triggers out-of-state rules (>14 days): needs manager + HR + Finance approval. Security: VPN required, MDM device. Within 42-day annual limit.

questions.question: Can you create an HR ticket for a PTO request for EMP003 for October 6-8? My employee ID is EMP003.
questions.gold_answer: Agent should show a preview first (requires_confirmation: true) before creating the ticket. After confirmation, TKT-XXXXXXXX is created.

questions.question: I need some time off.
questions.gold_answer: Agent should ask clarifying questions: How many days? When? What type (PTO, sick leave, parental, bereavement)? What is your employee ID?

questions.question: I have an issue with my manager.
questions.gold_answer: Agent should ask for clarification (performance issue vs. harassment vs. conflict) and provide relevant policy guidance and reporting options based on the clarification.

questions.question: Can I expense this?
questions.gold_answer: Agent should ask: what is the item/expense, how much, and what is the business purpose? Without this information, cannot answer.

questions.question: I want to work from another country.
questions.gold_answer: Agent should ask which country, for how long, and what the employee's role and ID are. International remote work requires VP, Legal, Finance, and IT Security approval — but specifics depend on the destination.

questions.question: Can you help me file my personal federal income tax return?
questions.gold_answer: Agent should decline: this is outside HR policy scope. Suggest EAP financial planning services (POL-004).

questions.question: What are the best restaurants near the San Francisco office?
questions.gold_answer: Agent should decline: outside HR policy scope.

questions.question: Can you write a Python script to automate my Excel reports?
questions.gold_answer: Agent should decline: outside HR policy scope.

questions.question: What is the current stock price of Acme Corp?
questions.gold_answer: Agent should decline: outside HR policy scope.
